description: Measure and improve performance, resilience, and deployment readiness.
exit_contract: repeatable baseline, variance, findings, and bounded recommendation

invalidate_on: source evidence becomes stale or fails verification

gates: select only atomic steps whose trigger matches and prerequisites are current

steps.condition: Select only when the atomic requested outcome matches: Assess an authorized cloud architecture against provider-specific failure, recovery, scaling, dependency, and operational practices using read-only evidence.
hard_gates: Reliability assessment is read-only and evidence-bounded; it cannot perform failover, scale, restart, reconfigure, restore, or claim resilience from architecture diagrams alone.
Preflight never changes remote state; observation never executes recovery; coordination never performs specialist actions; one remote authorization never cascades.
inputs: Architecture evidence, provider, availability target, dependencies, traffic, and recovery objectives.

steps.condition: Select only when the atomic requested outcome matches: Measure current frontend rendering and interaction performance under a frozen user journey and identify evidence-backed bottlenecks without source repair.
hard_gates: A frontend performance finding requires a frozen journey, representative device profile, warmup, sample count, distribution, budget, and repeatable trace; one fast or slow run is not evidence.
Independent review, QA, audit, acquisition, analysis, and triage never imply remediation; setup or authentication never implies downstream action authority.
inputs: A rendered frontend, interaction traces, performance measurements, and device constraints.

steps.condition: Select only when the atomic requested outcome matches: Read-only assess Kubernetes workload, cluster, identity, policy, scaling, networking, migration, health, and rollback readiness before deployment.
hard_gates: Readiness authority is read-only: no apply, patch, rollout, scale, restart, secret read, policy change, or namespace mutation is permitted.
Preflight never changes remote state; observation never executes recovery; coordination never performs specialist actions; one remote authorization never cascades.
inputs: Cluster and workload configuration, provider controls, expected traffic, failure budget, and deployment plan.

steps.condition: Select only when the atomic requested outcome matches: Diagnose and verify nondeterminism, retries, timeouts, cleanup, isolation, ordering, and recovery behavior under a frozen workload without source repair.
hard_gates: A resilience claim requires repeated target-bound evidence with recorded seeds, ordering, environment, retries, timeouts, side effects, cleanup, and failure injection; one passing retry proves nothing.
Independent review, QA, audit, acquisition, analysis, and triage never imply remediation; setup or authentication never implies downstream action authority.
inputs: A confirmed cause involving invalid data, races, environment contamination, fragile waits, or flaky tests.

steps.condition: Select only when the atomic requested outcome matches: Measure a frozen Web page or journey for navigation, network, caching, assets, rendering, and Core Web Vitals under declared conditions without repair.
hard_gates: A Web performance claim requires repeated runs with recorded browser, device, network, cache, warmup, sample count, distribution, budget, and target identity; a single Lighthouse score cannot pass.
Independent review, QA, audit, acquisition, analysis, and triage never imply remediation; setup or authentication never implies downstream action authority.
inputs: A web application, controlled sampling environment, network waterfall, and build information.
outputs: Core Web Vitals and waterfall evidence
